findings.headline: Hallucination Resistance: 98% — minor, −2 pts to a perfect score

findings.headline: Task Success: 95% — minor, −5 pts to a perfect score
problem: The agent answered the CEO/company entity-merge question with a generic personal-data refusal template instead of addressing it.
The agent accepted the false '20 oz' premise and answered only half of the question.
The agent gave an irrelevant EcoShine reply and never explicitly corrected the false premise in that turn.
fix: Route company and entity lookups to a scoped business-information answer instead of the personal-data refusal template.
Add a premise-check step that flags false user assumptions, such as unit or spec claims, before answering.
